##: Upstream has no releases/tags: pure-Python (stdlib + ctypes) tray tool. This manifest pulls the main-branch source zip and writes two command wrappers. No upstream checksum exists, so the hash was computed from the archive at packaging time; no autoupdate because there are no tags to track.
description: 读取 2.4G 无线外设（鼠标/耳机）电量的小工具，纯 ctypes 零第三方依赖
notes: 需要 Python 3.10+ 且带 tkinter（scoop install python 或官网安装包）
battery-viewer：命令行打印一次电量（--once）或多设备交互
battery-viewer-tray：常驻托盘（pythonw 启动，不弹黑窗）
上游无 LICENSE 文件，license 记为 Unknown；上游也没有 release/tag，本包是 main 分支快照（version = 提交 sha）
pre_install: $cli = @('@echo off','setlocal','set "PY="','for %%c in (python python3 python312 python313 py) do (','    if not defined PY ( where %%c >nul 2>nul && set "PY=%%c" )',')','if not defined PY ( echo battery-viewer needs Python 3.10+ on PATH. Try: scoop install python & exit /b 1 )','%PY% "%~dp0my_devices.py" %*')

$tray = @('@echo off','setlocal','set "PY="','for %%c in (pythonw python python3 python312 py) do (','    if not defined PY ( where %%c >nul 2>nul && set "PY=%%c" )',')','if not defined PY ( echo battery-viewer-tray needs Python 3.10+ with tkinter & exit /b 1 )','start "" %PY% "%~dp0tray_app.py"')
